title: Dev Team BR delivery buypass-atl105-mastercard: completeness and Mastercard coverage review
reviewer: Test Solution team (independent review; curated judgements, not SME approval)

dispositions.COVERED: The Dev BR explicitly states or models the requirement (scenario, code, flow leg, carried field, required segment or explicit source citation).
dispositions.PARTIAL: The Dev BR models part of the requirement, or models it with a defect or open gap.
dispositions.CONTEXT_ONLY: The Dev BR has the transaction context in which the requirement applies but does not state it; per-scenario 'supporting rules' are counts only and cannot be traced. Not counted as covered.
dispositions.NOT_COVERED: Neither the requirement nor a Dev scenario/dimension that expresses it exists in the Dev BR.
dispositions.CONFLICT: The Dev BR models something the specification restricts; needs SME decision.
dispositions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Not a Mastercard requirement (other network/card type or non-financial flow); excluded from the denominator.
dispositions.EXTERNAL_SOURCE: Governed by a source that is not in this repository; reported but excluded from the ATL105 denominator.

R-EXPLICIT-CODES.text: Dev scenarios declare the Appendix G transaction type code(s) and the Appendix E card type (020 Credit / 080 MasterCard fleet), i.e. the Prompt Code composition.

R-EMV-SEG130.text: Dev EMV-entry scenarios (05/95, 07/86) use the EMV Financial Transaction Request with required Segment 130; chip-fallback and magnetic-stripe scenarios do not.

R-EMV-REVERSAL.text: Dev EMV follow-on legs (purchase reversal, TOR, cancellation, completion) use a Financial Transaction Request without Segment 130.

R-SEQ-CARRY.text: Dev flows carry the original Sequence Number on completion, sale void, refund void, cancellation and TOR legs.

R-APPROVAL-MISSING.text: Dev follow-on legs carry Sequence Number (and Terminal Identifier for TOR) only; the Approval Number (Element 5) that section 10.1.2.2 requires to be present and identical in an Authorization Only Reversal is never stated.

R-FIELD.text: Dev has the transaction context but states no field/segment-level rule; its per-scenario 'supporting rules' are counts only and cannot be traced to this requirement.

R-SEG111.text: Dev has the transaction context but no Segment 111 (Variable Information) requirement.

R-RESPONSE.text: Dev models request legs only; no response, response-code or response-segment requirement is stated.

R-AMOUNT.text: Dev has the purchase contexts but states no amount requirement.

R-TOKEN.text: Dev has no payment-token / DSRP / In-App dimension; Segment 123 and token rules are absent.

R-3DS.text: Dev has no e-commerce / 3-D Secure channel; UCAF, AAV and ECI rules are absent.

R-TRANSARMOR.text: Dev has no TransArmor dimension (Token Registration T is excluded).

R-PIN.text: Dev has no PIN / cardholder-verification dimension.

R-PARTIAL-APPROVAL.text: Dev models no Partial Approval scenario (Element 121 indicator, Response Code F, approved-amount handling).

R-NEGATIVE.text: Dev states no negative / invalid-value requirement.

R-EXTERNAL.text: Depends on an external contract (issuer, routing, clearing, settlement, audit) outside ATL105 message scope; Dev states nothing.

R-CARD-STATUS.text: Card status (blocked/lost/stolen) is issuer behaviour; neither Dev nor the Test Solution has a BR.

R-TOR-ORDER.text: Dev models original -> TOR only; the queued TOR sent ahead of the next financial request from the same device is not modelled.

R-TIMEOUT.text: Dev models TOR follow-ons but not the 30-second response interval, timeout detection or late-response handling.

R-FLEET-145.text: Dev cites the MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV Prompt Table rule (p.289) but its Fleet EMV scenarios require Segment 130 only, not Segment 145.

R-FLEET-NOTICE.text: Dev does not reflect the MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV production availability notice.

R-ENTRY-LIFECYCLE.text: Dev persists Appendix J PAN entry codes across legs (e.g. 02/90 on both legs) but does not state the 90 -> 02 follow-up exception or the terminal capability (position 3).

R-OTHER-NETWORK.text: Rule is specific to another network or card type (Accel/STAR, Money Code, Comdata), not Mastercard.

R-ACCOUNT-VERIFICATION.text: Transaction type A (Account Verification) is not a section 10.1.2 supported MasterCard credit transaction; Dev correctly excluded it, so the classification BR is not a Mastercard requirement.

R-LOAD-FLOW.text: Non-financial terminal load/download flow; a Mastercard financial BR does not cover it (Dev excludes Transaction Type 9 special transactions).

R-ACCOUNT-UPDATER.text: Dev models no Real-Time Account Updater request/response.

R-PROMPT-FAMILY.text: Dev uses Appendix E financial card types (020 Credit, 080 MasterCard fleet) and excludes special Type 9 prompts.

R-SEC5.text: Dev uses program labels Credit/Fleet without the Section 5 payment-network taxonomy.

R-LIFECYCLE-REFS.text: Dev carries Sequence Number and Terminal Identifier, but not Approval Number or the MasterCard Transaction Link Identifier.

R-EMV-APPR.text: Segment 130 inclusion is stated; Appendix R chip-data framing and cross-field consistency are not.

R-SEC5-NETWORK.text: Dev has a network selection (MasterCard) but no Section 5 leaf classification.
